title: 2026 MTV Video Music Awards: What You Didn’t See On TV
summary: A superstar reunion, a Swift surprise, pink-veiled Madonna fans and more.
contentText:
It was a big night for Madonna and Taylor Swift at the 2026 MTV Video Music Awards, where both superstars came into the night as the year’s top nominees — and they were also the evening’s biggest winners .

Madonna not only opened the show with a medley of songs from her Confessions II album (joined by Sabrina Carpenter and Charli xcx), she also walked away with seven trophies, including three wins onstage (artist of the year, best dance and best collaboration). As for Swift, she won a trio of Moon Persons: the first-ever Artist Director Honors, video of the year (both presented onstage) and best direction.

Inside the Peacock Theater in downtown Los Angeles, there were moments viewers at home never saw — including an encounter between Madonna and Swift (more on that in a second). The venue felt at once intimate and immense, its expansive stage anchored by a towering Moon Person. Early arrivals watched the production crew make last-minute preparations and deliver instructions to the enthusiastic fans recruited to surround the stage.

Once the show got underway, the mixture of veteran acts (Madonna, host Snoop Dogg) and newer faces (LISA, Sienna Spiro) kept the audience engaged. Seemingly the biggest in-venue response went to the Michael tribute, where the audience was on its feet the entire time — no doubt thanks to the fact that Michael’s sterling catalog of hits was well-known by the crowd.

Here’s a rundown of some of the moments viewers did not see at home on TV during the MTV Video Music Awards.
